# Credits and source provenance

## Main visual and motion reference

Prismic **Farbe.film** template, copied by the user to https://github.com/mara420/NOv-1.
Original: https://github.com/prismicio-community/nuxt-starter-prismic-farbe.
Reference revision: `e29381843f395d4936ff4f4cc33062ed2d81393f`.
Copyright 2013–2025 Prismic <contact@prismic.io>.
Licensed under Apache License 2.0; full text: `licenses/NOv-1-Apache-2.0.txt`.

This work adapts its palette and typography, 60/40 composition, full-screen scene, data-scene section model, scroll-driven rotation, picture transitions and picture grid. The source components were reviewed directly. Modified equivalents in this project: `style.css`, `js/app.js` and `js/garden-scene.js`. `js/garden-fallback.js` provides an original software-rendered garden for browsers without WebGL. They are marked with adaptation comments. Original film models, product images, Prismic CMS and commerce integrations are not distributed in this site. The garden geometry and Zafis-specific content are new.

## Runtime

Three.js 0.180.0, Copyright © 2010–2025 three.js authors, MIT license (`licenses/three-MIT.txt`). Vendored module files in `js/vendor/`; only the relative local import was renamed.

## Fonts

Inter and Geist Mono, obtained from Google Fonts and self-hosted. Subset to Latin and Latin Extended characters and common punctuation, converted to WOFF. SIL Open Font License 1.1, full texts in `licenses/Inter-OFL.txt` and `licenses/GeistMono-OFL.txt`.
